description: Enlarge an image (default 2x, or to a width/height up to 8192 px). Runs the upscaler model chosen in Kokon (Superscale-SP by default; seconds on a PC GPU, longer on a Mac; adds no new content). Saves a new file; the input is never overwritten.

height.description: Target height in pixels; width follows the aspect ratio unless also given

image_path.description: Image to upscale (absolute, or relative to the project)

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

scale.description: Enlargement factor, e.g. 2 (default 2 when no width/height is given)

width.description: Target width in pixels; height follows the aspect ratio unless also given

name: upscale_image
title: Upscale image
